reason: Every rupee we can spare is going into the wedding fund right now, and the women at home already wash by hand for free. Adding a ₹2,000 EMI every month for a year just so the washing finishes during a power cut is not something I can justify this year.
objection: ₹1,999 a month is a new fixed payment while we are saving, and the battery only does two cold loads, so I am paying a lot extra over a basic machine for something hand-washing already covers.
would_change_my_mind: An EMI under ₹1,000 a month, or the offer coming after the wedding when the savings pressure is off.
